translated_title: Vicente Fox and Former PAN Governors Defend Ruffo Appel and Allege ‘Political Persecution’
original_title: Vicente Fox y ex gobernadores panistas defienden a Ruffo Appel y acusan "persecución política"
author: Juan Carlos G. Partida
meta_description: PAN ex-officials say Ruffo Appel, charged with fuel smuggling and organized crime, was sent to a maximum-security prison despite frail health at over 70.
